translations.b0502: Part 18  Strengthening Guarantees for Plan Implementation
translations.b0503: China will uphold and strengthen the Party’s overall leadership, persevere in advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance, enhance the Party’s political leadership, ideological guidance, organizational strength and social appeal, improve the Party’s ability and level in leading economic and social development, and improve the institutional system for national economic and social development planning, thereby gathering a mighty force for advancing Chinese modernization.
translations.b0504: Chapter 61  Upholding and Strengthening the Centralized, Unified Leadership of the Party Central Committee
translations.b0505: China will resolutely safeguard the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, give full play to the Party’s role as the core of leadership in exercising overall leadership and coordinating the efforts of all sides, and provide a fundamental guarantee for advancing plan implementation.
translations.b0506: Section 1  Strengthening the Party’s Leadership over the Whole Process of Plan Implementation
translations.b0507: China will thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and continue to use the Party’s innovative theory to unify thinking, will and action. The mechanisms for implementing the major decisions and plans of the Party Central Committee will be improved, overall coordination, guidance and promotion of plan implementation will be strengthened, a work pattern of plan implementation featuring clear division of responsibilities, coordinated action and extensive participation will be formed, and smooth connection between higher and lower levels and effective implementation will be ensured. Democratic centralism will be improved and implemented, and scientific, democratic and law-based decision-making will be upheld. In-depth efforts will be made to tackle pointless formalities and ease the burden on grassroots levels. Requests for instructions and reports will be promptly submitted to the Party Central Committee concerning the mid-term and final evaluations of the Plan and major issues in implementation, and all regions and departments shall report to the Party Central Committee on the implementation of the Plan’s objectives and tasks as an important part of their work. The building of primary-level Party organizations in all fields will be advanced in a coordinated manner, the political and organizational functions of Party organizations will be enhanced, and Party members will play their vanguard and exemplary role. The policy of respecting work, respecting knowledge, respecting talent and respecting creativity will be implemented, the vitality of the whole of society in taking action, starting businesses, innovating and creating will be stimulated, and a lively situation will be created in which everyone’s talent is fully applied, all abilities are put to the best use, and the whole nation works with one heart and advances with united efforts.
translations.b0508: Section 2  Comprehensively Enhancing the Modernization Capabilities of the Contingent of Officials
translations.b0509: A correct approach to selecting and appointing officials will be upheld, political criteria will be put first, and leading bodies and the contingent of officials will be built strong. Officials at all levels will be educated and guided to establish and practice a correct view of political performance, proceed from reality and act in accordance with objective laws, consciously deliver achievements for the people and through solid work, promote high-quality and sustainable development with a correct view of political performance, and respond to the people’s new requirements and expectations with real results. The differentiated assessment and evaluation system will be improved, making assessment more targeted and scientific. Education, training and practical exercise will be strengthened to enhance the modernization capabilities of officials. Strict management will be combined with genuine care, and incentives with constraints, so as to stimulate the internal motivation and overall vitality of the contingent of officials.
translations.b0510: Section 3  Improving the Party and State Oversight System
translations.b0511: Full and rigorous Party self-governance will be advanced to higher standards and with more solid measures; an oversight system featuring unified Party leadership, full coverage, and authority and efficiency will be improved; the allocation and operation of power will be better regulated and supervised; institutional mechanisms that integrate the authorization, exercise and restraint of power and are clear, transparent and traceable will be improved; the enforcement of laws and regulations will be strengthened; and a clean and upright political ecosystem will be fostered. The political responsibility for full and rigorous Party self-governance will be strengthened, political oversight will be made more specific, targeted and routine, and the role of political inspection as a sharp sword will be brought into play. Persistent efforts will be made to implement the spirit of the Central Committee’s eight-point decision on improving Party and government conduct, all kinds of unhealthy tendencies will be resolutely curbed, and efforts to improve Party conduct will be made routine and lasting. A clear and firm stance that anti-corruption is always an ongoing endeavor will be maintained, coordinated efforts will be made to ensure that officials dare not, cannot and do not want to engage in corruption, the soil and conditions that breed corruption will be eliminated, the tough battle, protracted battle and overall battle against corruption will be resolutely fought and won, and the path of anti-corruption with Chinese characteristics will be unswervingly followed. Serious action will be taken to investigate and deal with the problem of collusion between officials and businesspeople that damages the political ecosystem and the environment for economic development; corruption in fields where power is concentrated, funds are intensive and resources are abundant will be strictly investigated; new and hidden forms of corruption will be effectively prevented and addressed; and efforts will continue to be deepened to rectify misconduct and corruption around the people. Oversight of “top officials”, other members of the “key few” and other key groups such as young officials will be strengthened, and the practice of investigating both those who take bribes and those who give bribes will be deepened. National anti-corruption legislation will be advanced. With intra-Party oversight taking the lead, all forms of oversight will be promoted in a coordinated and interconnected way, and cooperation and coordination mechanisms between discipline inspection and supervision and audit oversight, fiscal and accounting oversight, statistical oversight and other forms of oversight will be deepened and expanded. International anti-corruption cooperation will be strengthened, mechanisms for repatriating fugitives, preventing their escape and recovering illicit assets will be built in an integrated way, and efforts to address cross-border corruption will be intensified. Reform of the discipline inspection and supervision system will be deepened, and discipline inspection and supervision will be made more standardized, law-based and regularized.
translations.b0512: Chapter 62  Improving the Full-Cycle Mechanism for Plan Implementation
translations.b0513: China will implement the National Development Planning Law, improve the unified planning system, fully mobilize the enthusiasm, initiative and creativity of the whole of society, advance the implementation of all objectives and tasks vigorously and in an orderly manner, and ensure that the decisions and plans of the Party Central Committee are fully implemented.
translations.b0514: Section 1  Forging Synergy in a Unified Planning System
translations.b0515: A national planning system that is accurately positioned, clearly bounded, functionally complementary and uniformly connected will be established and improved, providing effective support for the implementation of the national development plan. In accordance with the national development plan, a number of national-level key special plans and national-level regional implementation programs will be deployed, formulated and implemented in step. The formulation of plans at all levels and of all types will be coordinated: the number of plans will be reduced, their quality improved, and linkages and coordination among plans strengthened, so as to prevent excessive, indiscriminate and ineffective planning. Procedures for linking plans and submitting them for approval will be standardized; plans submitted to the Party Central Committee and the State Council for approval must be linked with the national development plan through the development and reform department of the State Council; and provincial-level development plans must, in accordance with procedures, be submitted to the development and reform department of the State Council for linkage, with implementation duly ensured. Provincial-level governments will strengthen their guidance on the formulation of city and county plans, ensuring that the layout of major industries, major infrastructure and other areas conforms to national strategic priorities. Annual plans will implement all the tasks of the Plan on a rolling basis; the main indicators of the Plan will be broken down and incorporated into the annual plan indicator system, with comprehensive balance maintained from year to year. The supporting laws, regulations and policies for the National Development Planning Law will be improved, standardized management of national-level special plans will be strengthened, and local governments will be encouraged to formulate development planning regulations for their own regions in light of actual conditions.
translations.b0516: Section 2  Advancing the Implementation of Plan Tasks by Category
translations.b0517: China will establish and improve the plan implementation mechanism and clarify the division of responsibilities for objectives and tasks. All regions and departments shall formulate specific, actionable and assessable work arrangements and measures for implementation. For binding indicators, and for tasks such as public services, ecological and environmental protection and security guarantees, responsibility will be more effectively decomposed and fulfilled; for anticipatory indicators, and for tasks such as industrial development and structural adjustment, implementation will be advanced by creating a sound policy environment, institutional environment and law-based environment. The list of major engineering projects will be refined, and individual projects and bundled projects will be implemented by category; for projects for which preliminary work will be carried out during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, construction will be launched through prescribed procedures where conditions are ripe.
translations.b0519: Focusing on the implementation of the national development plan, mechanisms for policy coordination and work synergy will be improved. The national development plan will be taken as an important basis for assessing the consistency of the orientation of macro policies, ensuring that the direction in which all policies are applied conforms to the requirements of the national development plan. The financial guarantee provided by the medium-term fiscal plan and annual budget arrangements for plan implementation will be strengthened, and central government funds will be channeled first to the major strategic tasks, major policy measures and major engineering projects identified in the Plan. Financial policies will actively support the key development areas identified in the Plan. The principles that projects follow the plan, that funds and production factors follow projects, and that oversight follows projects and funds will be upheld; the approval and verification of major engineering projects identified in the Plan will be accelerated; priority will be given to meeting the needs of site selection, land and sea use and funding; and the land and other production factor needs of individual major engineering projects will be guaranteed by the state in a unified manner. Oversight of major engineering projects will be strengthened on an accompanying and look-through basis, and whole-process, full-cycle safety management will be strengthened.
translations.b0520: Section 4  Strengthening Monitoring, Evaluation and Oversight of Plan Implementation
translations.b0521: Dynamic monitoring, mid-term evaluation and final evaluation of plan implementation will be carried out; tracking of the situation and analysis of risks will be strengthened; and, on the basis of monitoring and evaluation, policy measures to strengthen and improve plan implementation will be promptly proposed. After approval by the Party Central Committee, the mid-term evaluation will, in accordance with the law, be reported to the NPC Standing Committee, and the final evaluation report will, in accordance with the law, be submitted to the National People’s Congress, so as to consciously accept oversight by people’s congresses. If evaluation shows that adjustments to this Plan are truly necessary, the State Council will put forward an adjustment plan and, after it is approved by the Party Central Committee, submit it to the NPC Standing Committee for review and approval. Improving the Party and state oversight system will be integrated into plan implementation; discipline inspection and supervision organs and audit organs will play their oversight role in plan implementation; and a coordinated oversight mechanism for the implementation of major cross-regional and cross-departmental tasks will be improved. Plan implementation will be made public in a timely manner and open to oversight by all sectors of society.
